crossRefs.note: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
“You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

translations.web: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
translations.bsb: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
translations.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
translations.asv: And he made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
